name: WebDAW
description: A tiny digital audio workstation: draw beats and melodies in a piano roll, play them on the keyboard and shape sounds with an 80s poly, super saw, reese bass and 808 kit. Four demo tracks included.
controls: Space play/stop · A–K play notes (Z/X octave) · tap the grid to add/delete notes, drag to move, drag edge to resize · R record · Ctrl+Z undo
